Need to search first.I can't give you any notes on Isaiah 61 yet, because I wasn't able to read any of the source pages.

My first attempt to open the commentary pages directly (Enduring Word, Precept Austin, BibleHub and Gill on StudyLight) was blocked. The tool only opens addresses that first turn up in a search. I then ran the searches, but I hit the limit on tool calls for this turn before any results came back. So I haven't read anything from Enduring Word, BibleHub, StudyLight, Precept Austin, the NET Bible notes, the Catholic or Orthodox sites, or the teachers from the different traditions.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say, with a link for each point. Anything I wrote now would come from my own memory, with no pages to cite, so I've left everything out.

If you ask again, I'll run the searches first and then read the pages they return. Those would include:
- **The usual reading, verse by verse:** Enduring Word, Ellicott, the Pulpit Commentary, Gill and Precept Austin.
- **Where Protestant traditions differ:** probably verses 1–2 (Jesus reads them in Luke 4 and stops before "the day of vengeance"), verse 6 ("priests of the LORD") and verse 10 ("robe of righteousness"). For each, I'd use teachers from that tradition.
- **Other views:** the NET Bible notes and Bible Odyssey for modern scholarship, Catholic and Orthodox sources, and how prosperity teaching uses the "double portion" in verse 7, as far as the allowed sites discuss it.

Then I'll write the notes verse by verse, with a link after every point.
